name: 📣 Campaign Board
description: A marketing calendar the office runs: posts as cards with a channel and a date, copy drafted by an agent in your voice, an approval before anything is published, publishing through the tools your agents have (X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, a blog…).

commands.name: add
commands.desc: Plan a post (a card on the board, due that day)

commands.name: draft
commands.desc: Have an agent write the copy

commands.name: approve
commands.desc: Ask the owner to approve the copy (📥 APPROVALS / phone)

commands.name: publish
commands.desc: Publish an approved post through the agent's tools

commands.name: voice
commands.desc: Set the brand voice every draft follows
